decision_rule: Civil Defense first for fire explosion gas rescue and active life-safety danger; ISF if security or traffic control is needed.
examples: fire near houses; gas leak; person trapped
notes: Do not wait for municipality ownership before emergency response.

decision_rule: ISF first for threat weapon assault theft shooting or public order; Civil Defense only if rescue/fire/medical hazard is present.
notes: Keep HITL for safety and privacy.

decision_rule: ISF handles traffic/security control; Civil Defense if trapped injured or rescue needed.
examples: accident blocking road; crash with injured person
notes: Infrastructure repair follows after emergency triage.

decision_rule: Municipality/building safety review unless collapse is active or people are trapped.
examples: building crack; unsafe balcony; structural risk
notes: Active collapse becomes Civil Defense first.

decision_rule: Route local tree/pole hazards to municipality but verify whether electrical grid road asset or active rescue danger changes the path.
examples: dangerous tree; pole falling; tree on road
notes: Asset ownership is ambiguous by default.

decision_rule: Route routine public animal risk to municipality/local enforcement; escalate if active attack or injuries.
examples: stray dogs; aggressive dog near school
notes: Local handling varies and remains HITL.

decision_rule: Use municipal police/local enforcement for minor parking noise and obstruction where no serious threat exists.
examples: illegal parking; loud music; vendor blocking sidewalk
notes: Threat violence or major traffic danger moves toward ISF/HITL.

decision_rule: Use municipality first for visible unlicensed construction and permit issues; keep HITL for parcel evidence and danger.
notes: Urban planning or security escalation may be needed but is not auto-resolved here.

decision_rule: Route oversight complaints to Central Inspection and keep HITL for evidence privacy and criminal-boundary review.
examples: bribe request; complaint against public administration

decision_rule: Use DGLAC only for DGLAC/local-administration registration or form tracking; otherwise municipality remains first.
examples: DGLAC registration number; municipality form tracking
